title: Installation of the Inboard Flap Track No. 2 Support Rib on the Wing Rear Spar

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Installation of the inboard flap track number two support rib on the wing rear spar, covering the solid-film lubricant application, the torque sequence and the flap rigging and asymmetry check that follow.

sections.purpose: This task installs the inboard flap track number two support rib on the wing rear spar, sets the flap rigging and confirms by functional test that the flap system operates symmetrically.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm which rib standard is being installed. The reinforced rib uses a five-bolt pattern and needs two additional holes drilled with the jig; the original rib uses three bolts. Do not mix standards between the two wings without an engineering concession. The solid-film lubricant must be applied to a clean, dry surface and allowed to dry before the joint is closed.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the attachment holes have passed the eddy current inspection and that the ovality is inside the limit. 2. Where the reinforced standard is being installed, drill the two additional holes with the jig and do an eddy current inspection of each. 3. Clean the faying surfaces and apply the solid-film lubricant to the fitting D5730121797468 and the rib D5730125554505. CAUTION: LET THE SOLID-FILM LUBRICANT DRY FULLY BEFORE YOU CLOSE THE JOINT. A WET FILM WILL EXTRUDE AND LEAVE A GAP. 4. Position the rib on the spar fitting and fit the upper cleat GIR438406-76. 5. Install the attachment bolts and the barrel nuts AGS934342-5A finger tight. WARNING: DO NOT APPLY FULL TORQUE UNTIL EVERY BOLT IS FITTED. UNEVEN CLAMP-UP WILL PRELOAD THE SPAR BOOM. 6. Torque the bolts in the sequence given on drawing D57301146439. 7. Re-connect the damper at FIN 2VU. 8. Install the flap track and set the rigging to the values in the referenced data. 9. Restore hydraulic power and remove the flap trestles. 10. Do the flap operational test through the full range and confirm no binding. 11. Do the flap asymmetry check and confirm the recorded values against both wings.
sections.close_out: Close the trailing edge access panels and confirm the fastener torque. Remove the warning notices and the trestle set from the area. Confirm from the removal sheet that every bolt has been replaced. Record the rib standard, the torque values, the rigging values and the asymmetry check result against the aircraft.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the five-bolt pattern applies to aircraft post MOD-154120

safety_precautions: Keep the flap on the trestles until the rib is fully torqued.
Do not apply full torque before every bolt is fitted.
Restore hydraulic power only after the trestles are clear.
Wear gloves when you apply the solid-film lubricant.

tooling.description: Torque wrench 20-200 Nm with crowfoot set
